overview.description: The Vanguard Tax-Exempt Bond ETF (VTEB) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund tracks a market-value-weighted index of investment grade debt issued by state and local governments and agencies. Interest is exempt from US income tax and from AMT VTEB was launched on Aug 21, 2015 and is issued by Vanguard.
